channel.name: Pixel Tech
channel.description: Technology, AI, software, and emerging innovations explained for curious generalists.
channel.tagline: Technology, explained like a human is watching.

audience.what_they_know: Uses apps daily, follows tech news casually, has heard the headlines but not the mechanism.
audience.what_they_want: Clear mental models they can repeat to a friend, and a reason to care.

avoid: Listing statistics without explaining why they matter
prefer: Concrete analogies drawn from everyday life
Short sentences followed by one longer sentence
Naming real companies, people and products

video.hook_style: Open on a vivid scenario or counter-intuitive fact
video.ending_style: Return to the opening image and pose a genuine question

visuals.lighting: Volumetric light with soft bloom, deep shadows
visuals.texture: Subtle film grain, shallow depth of field

audio.mixing_style: Clear narration with balanced background audio
audio.energy: Builds from calm to confident, never aggressive
audio.notes: Narration always stays on top. Music sits far below speech.
